summary: No. So far it was one message from Phil posted in IRC. We should take this to #knownchat for others to see. I always find 4 gmt to be most amicable as it is 12 edt, and 9 pdt, almost impossible for Pacific contributors. Be a good problem to solve if folks get involved.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: No. So far it was one message from Phil posted in IRC. We should take this to #knownchat for others to see. I always find 4 gmt to be most amicable as it is 12 edt, and 9 pdt, almost impossible for Pacific contributors. Be a good problem to solve if folks get involved.
